text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — elevated 5xx (502/504) spike from inference-gateway -> model-runner pool in prod/us-east-1. Error rate ~12% over 2m. Paging oncall @mike-oncall.

mike-oncall: I'm on it, jumping into bridge now.

alice-ml: quick scan of model-runner logs shows repeated OOM + segfaults on runner-45 and runner-47. Likely KV cache growth from very long seq requests.

raj-sre: Confirmed. kubectl logs mr-runner-45 | tail -n 120 shows: 
```
[2026-03-17T03:00:12Z] runtime: Out of memory: Killed process 12345 (model-runner) total-vm:1250000000kB, anon-rss:1203456000kB
[2026-03-17T03:00:13Z] segfault at 0 ip 0x7f8a1234 sp 0x7ffd... error 4 in libattention.so
```
KV-cache usage: 1.2TB (OOM threshold 1.0TB). Autoscaler tried to add nodes but containers were being OOM-killed on startup.

lisa-prod: Customer impact: ~30% of generation requests returning 502. High-traffic customers (partner-alpha, partner-beta) reporting failures. Not degrading for embeddings.

mike-oncall: Mitigation plan (short): 1) Route new traffic away from affected runner pool to fallback variant (smaller model) 2) Apply runtime config to cap KV cache and reduce batch size 3) Kill runaway PIDs and restart nodes 4) Notify customers and status page.

mike-oncall: Applying routing change now: POST /control/routing/update {"from":"mistral-v1-16k-quant","to":"mistral-v1-8k-quant-fallback","percent":100,"region":"us-east-1"} 

deploy-bot: Routing update accepted, propagation started (req_id=rt-7b3a). Expected ~45s to reach edge.

alice-ml: While routing propagates, pushing a hotpatch to runtime config on pool mr-runner-prod-us-east-1: 
```
max_kv_cache_bytes: 800000000000
max_batch_tokens: 4096
max_batch_size: 4
prefetch_long_seq: false
```
Patching config via ansible: ansible-playbook playbooks/runtime-patch.yml --limit=mr-runner-prod-us-east-1 -e @hotpatch-vars.yml

raj-sre: Executing targeted kill on runaway process on runner-45: `ssh runner-45 sudo kill -9 12345` -> systemd restarted container. Node is back up but marked degraded. Restart of runner-47 in progress.

lisa-prod: Status page update drafted: 
"We are investigating elevated 5xx errors affecting text generation in us-east-1. Traffic is being routed to a fallback model and mitigations are in progress. Some customers may see higher latency temporarily. Updates to follow."

carol-support: Notifying CS escalation team and drafting messages for partner-alpha and partner-beta. Asking for expected ETA on mitigation timeline.

mike-oncall: Observability: error rate dropped from 12% -> 3% within 90s after routing change. Latency increased ~35-60ms for affected calls. Monitoring for regressions for 15m.

alice-ml: Hotpatch applied to 6/8 nodes; remaining nodes are cycling due to kernel OOM on restart. We're isolating a regression in recent attention-quant kernel that mis-handles very long KV sequences. Reverting that kernel build to previous stable in parallel.

raj-sre: Autoscaler policy temporarily disabled to avoid noisy scaling while we stabilize. Manual scale + cordon on degraded nodes.

mike-oncall: Next actions: (1) keep routing to fallback model for 30m (2) continue rolling restart with patched runtime (3) revert attention kernel if segfaults persist (4) prepare post-incident customer impact summary.

carol-support: ETA for customer-facing follow-up: 45m with impact summary and workaround suggestions.

deploy-bot: Kernel rollback job started on pool mr-runner-prod-us-east-1 (job_id=kr-88a). Will report completion.

lisa-prod: Telemetry shows partner-alpha rate now back to normal, partner-beta still reports intermittent 502s (10% of requests). Taking partner-beta traffic to a separate fallback route for targeted mitigation.

mike-oncall: Good. Assigning postmortem owner: alice-ml. Incident recorded as elevated-infer-5xx-3033033033. ICM will be updated with timeline.

incident-bot: Incident created: elevated-infer-5xx-3033033033. Commander: mike-oncall. Severity: Sev2.

mike-oncall: I'll stay on the bridge for 30m and then hand off to oncall rotation. If anyone sees new segfaults in logs, ping @mike-oncall and @raj-sre immediately.

carol-support: Copy — sending initial customer messages now.

-- end thread --
